items.text: Children above 5 years are considered adults, while those below 5 years are complimentary, subject to availability of jeep seat.

The timing of Jeep Safari in Kaziranga National Park is from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM in the morning and from 1:30 PM to 3:00 PM in the afternoon.

blocks.text: Safari Zones in Kaziranga National Park

content.text: This zone is the prime zone of Kaziranga, therefore, the probability of seeing a tiger, rhino, swamp deer etc is high here. It is also the most preferred zone for tourists visiting Kaziranga.
This zone attracts most of the animals of Kaziranga to quench their thirst due to the presence of water bodies . Therefore, prime animals of Kaziranga can easily be sighted here.
This zone is suitable for Jeep Safari as National Highway passes through this zone. Even wildlife photography is permissible in this zone.
Burapahar Zone is located in Gorakati which is 40 km away from the entry. This zone is a famous spot for trekking in Kaziranga.

main.title: How To Reach Kaziranga National Park

content.text: You can take a cab to reach Kaziranga National Park via NH 2 from Guwahati which will take around 3 hr 48 min. The distance between Guwahati and Kaziranga is about 191.5 km.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Jeep Safari Booking at Kaziranga National Park

items.question: 1. Which zone is famous for doing Jeep Safari in Kaziranga?

answer.text: The best zones for doing jeep safari in Kaziranga are Central Zone (Kohora) and Western Zone (Bagori), because these zones contain a great number of population of prime animals like tiger, rhino etc.
Yes, Kaziranga is safe for its visitors but visitors are advised to follow the necessary instructions given by the authorities.

items.question: 3. Among the four zones of Kaziranga National Park, which zone is more preferable?

answer.text: Among its four zones the Central Zone (Kohara) is the most preferable zone within Kaziranga for its visitors because this zone is situated in the center, and one can easily see the prime animals of Kaziranga out here.

items.question: 3. How many persons are allowed in one jeep?

answer.text: A maximum of 6 persons are allowed in one jeep. Five adults and one child below four years of age.

items.question: 4. Can we carry mobile phones inside Kaziranga National Park?

answer.text: Yes, carrying a cell phone is allowed inside the national park but in some parts of Kaziranga cellular networks are very bad, and in these places you will not be able to contact through your cell phones.

items.question: 5. How can I go from Guwahati to Kaziranga?

answer.text: You can book a cab from Guwahati to Kaziranga National Park. The distance from Guwahati to Kaziranga is about 191.5 km by road via NH 2 and the travelling duration will be around 3 hr 48 min.

items.question: 6. How much time does it take to complete a jeep safari tour in Kaziranga National Park?

answer.text: For completing a jeep safari tour it takes about two hours and thirty minutes. There are only two slots available, the first one is in the morning from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM and the second one is in the afternoon from 1:00 PM to 3:30 PM.

items.question: 7. What is popular about Kaziranga National Park?

answer.text: Kaziranga National Park is home to numerous wild cats, Royal Bengal Tigers and Leopards. The Kaziranga National Park creates a home-like environment for various types of plants and animals which makes it famous and attractive in the eyes of its visitors.

items.question: 8. What animals can we see inside the Kaziranga?

answer.text: Inside the Kaziranga National Park you can see its five prime animals like One-Horned Rhinoceros, the Bengal Tiger, the Asian Elephant, the Wild Buffalo and the Swamp Deer. And if you are lucky enough, you can also see its rare species like large cats and leopards.

items.question: 9. Are there any other places that are also available for exploring within Kaziranga National Park?

answer.text: Yes, Orchid Biodiversity Park can be explored along with Kaziranga National Park.
